excerpt: Canada Creates a New PR Pathway for Doctors By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: February 2026 · 5 min read If you’re an international doctor already working in Canada — or planning to — this is one of the most important immigration announcements in years. In December 2025, the federal government confirmed a set of targeted immigration measures designed specifically to increase Canada’s supply of physicians. These measures go far beyond general healthcare priorities and, for the first time, create a dedicated Express Entry category
